about: Curated points to compare. Coordinates are Moon-fixed mean-Earth/polar-axis: latitude north-positive, longitude east-positive, degrees. Every site names its source; add new ones the same way.

nssdc-apollo.title: NASA NSSDCA, Apollo Landing Site Coordinates (Lunar Module positions from LRO images; Wagner et al. 2017)

wikipedia.title: Wikipedia article coordinates, retrieved 2026-11-14. Crater positions there cite the IAU Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature. Check against the primary source before relying on them.

sites.name: Shackleton crater
sites.note: Centre of the crater: a reference point, not a vetted landing site. Many crater floors near the pole are permanently shadowed, which the smooth-sphere model cannot show.
